prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1460; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person, and refer any inquiries from your insured or their representatives to us as well.

Kindly provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any surveillance or investigative materials. Please also instruct your insured to preserve their vehicle, mobile device records, and any related documentation until this matter is resolved.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
